findings.issue: The answer-move line drops the explicit hybridization scope limit, leaving the advice to answer with geometry or hybridization misleadingly unqualified.
findings.evidence: The SOURCE limits hybridization labels to sp3, requires only the shape for a central atom with more than four electron pairs, and excludes d-orbital hybridization and molecular orbital theory. None of these limits appears in the PROPOSED summary.

findings.issue: Omitting "as a solid" broadens the point-loss warning and changes its meaning.
findings.evidence: The SOURCE warns against calling an ionic solid conductive "as a solid," when lattice ions are fixed. The PROPOSED line warns against simply "Calling an ionic solid conductive," which can falsely imply that ionic substances remain nonconductive when their ions become mobile.
